## Summary
Every environment operation is kernel-mediated (R-NOSIDE) and every effect
passes through the monitor before it can commit. This slice lands both
halves as the new persistent crate `crates/hh-env`: the environment side
(`EnvironmentRecord`, `EnvHandle`, `EnvDriver`, the honest `local_host`/
`local_sandboxed` classes) and the execution side (the seven-stage
`Dispatcher`, `ToolExecutor`/`ExecutorDeclaration`, attribution tokens,
capture items and manifests, the error taxonomy).

- **Environment abstraction** (`hh-env/src/{record,handle,driver,local,
  snapshot,seal}.rs`) — `EnvironmentClass::{LocalHost, LocalSandboxed}`
  with honest `isolation_class` (`None`/`ProcessSandbox`, never coerced
  up); `ImageRef::{ContentAddress, ForeignDigest, Tag}` — `resolve`
  refuses a bare mutable tag unless the record's `unpinned` set names it,
  a foreign digest is a recorded claim that fails `check_repro("R2")`, and
  only a content address is R2 identity. `EnvHandle` is a runtime object
  (not a record, not a capability): `declared → ready → torn_down` (+
  `unreachable`), roots/sessions/health, the containment `PolicySlot` and
  the stored `ContainmentReport`, `EnvMeters` with the three kernel clocks
  (`reserved ⊇ active + suspended`, kernel-dead gap excluded from
  `active`). `EnvDriver` owns provision/attach/verify/detach/teardown/
  heal/fs ops/`path_baseline` and appends the `action.environment.*`
  family. **`attach` is fail-closed**: `security.containment.applied`/
  `unverified` then `action.environment.attached{applied_ref}` then
  `ready` — `unknown`/degraded evidence is `ContainmentUnverified`, never
  `ready`. `heal` reattaches within the declared window and probes — never
  re-executes. `hh-identity` gains `RecordKind::EnvironmentRecord`.
- **Sandboxed execution** (`hh-env/src/{dispatch,executor,tokens,capture,
  observe,errors,deadline,protocol}.rs`) — `Dispatcher` runs the seven
  stages `resolve → authorize → prepare → commit → execute → capture →
  observe` over a `ToolExecutor`, minting `action.effect.intended` →
  `security.permission.decided` (the dispatcher mints the monitor's
  verdict — the durable write-ahead gate) → `authorized` → `prepared`
  (`baseline_ref` for `reversible` — the same `path_baseline` snapshot the
  post-exec diff reads) → `committed` (allow-gated; `read_only` skips
  write-ahead) → `action.tool.started` → `completed`/`rejected` →
  `observed`/`refused`/`unknown`. Tool terminals carry the `tool_call`
  chain only — never `effect_id` (the scope is closed earlier in the
  batch); the dedup-path `rejected` anchors at `{turn_id, model_call_id}`.
- **Attribution** — `TokenMinter` mints at prepare (`attribution_token_
  hash` on `prepared`); every `ExecutorSignal` resolves through
  `TokenResolver`, and a miss appends `action.effect.unattributed`
  (scope-free marker + hashed token) — the payload never enters the
  manifest. Executor output is report-only; kernel-derived observations
  are authoritative.
- **Capture & redaction** — `CaptureItem` kinds (output/terminal/progress/
  fs_change) with `fs_change` kernel-derived from the baseline diff (never
  executor-reported); `EffectCaptureManifest::seal` excludes ephemeral
  items so `capture_manifest_ref` is chunking-invariant. Redaction runs on
  the capture path before manifest/blob persistence; a non-placeholder hit
  on executor-reported payload emits `security.secret.leak_detected`.
- **Executor surface** — `ExecutorDeclaration`/`bind` refusals
  (`InsufficientDedup`, `InsufficientIsolation`,
  `InterruptSupport::Unknown` reported never coerced); the `ErrorClass` sum
  with the three-origin rule (declared classes ⇒ `tool`; undeclared ⇒
  `protocol_error`/`transport`) and kernel-derived `retryable`
  (`retryable_hint` lowers only, I-3); deadline/interrupt/streaming/dedup;
  `LocalExecutor` (in-process, `IsolationClass::None`) +
  `LocalHelperExecutor` (the spawn boundary the S2.1 binary owns) +
  `protocol.rs` helper schema.
- **Assessor inputs are honest derivations** — `command_parse` is `Some`
  only for `Exec`/`SpawnProcess` (non-command arg shapes are not `Failed`
  parses); `compensator_covered`/`compensation_registered` derive from the
  sealed plan id; `child_contained` is vacuous-yes/`Unknown` (Π-9 denies
  on `Unknown`).
- **`hh-ledger`** — the `action.environment.*` family, `action.tool.
  {started,completed,rejected}`, `action.effect.unattributed`;
  `EFFECT_FIELDS` gains `ordinal`, `baseline_ref`,
  `attribution_token_hash`, `capture_manifest_ref`; `prepared` on a
  `reversible` class requires `baseline_ref`.

## Decisions
ADR-0249 — the `hh-env` crate shape; `EnvHandle` as a runtime object, not
a record or capability; fail-closed `attach` with the stored report before
`ready`; honest `isolation_class`; the three kernel clocks; image identity
is content identity or nothing; the `action.environment.*` rows are
non-audit kernel-origin.

ADR-0250 — the seven stages; the dispatcher mints `decided`; baseline at
`prepare` doubling as the `reversible` `baseline_ref`; every signal
resolves the minted token (`unattributed` marker otherwise); tool
terminals carry only the `tool_call` chain; honest assessor-input
derivations; redaction on the capture path; `read_only` skips the
write-ahead; classification surjectivity + kernel-derived retryability;
the manifest excludes ephemeral items; the Stage-1 executor split.
